raw_ocr_text:
DEED

This Deed is made on June 28, 2006,

BETWEEN  Gerald K. Keller and Sharon B. Keller, Tenants in Common, having an
address of P.O. Box 2650, Cherry Hill, New Jersey 08034, referred to as the Grantors,

AND  Cherry Hill PlazaS LLC, having an address c/o Levites Realty Co., Inc., 341
East 149th Street, Bronx, NY 10451, referred to as the Grantee.

1.  Transfer of Ownership.  The Grantors grant and convey (transfers ownership) of
the property described below to the Grantee.  This transfer is made for the sum of
Two Million, Five Hundred Fifty Thousand Dollars ($2,550,000.00).  The Grantors
acknowledge receipt of this money.

2.  Tax Map Reference.  (N.J.S.A. 46:15-2.1) Municipality of Cherry Hill,
Block 426.01, Lot 17 of the Official Tax Map.

3.  Property.  The property consists of the land in the Township of Cherry Hill, County
of Camden and State of New Jersey.  The legal description is:

SEE SCHEDULE A ATTACHED HERETO AND MADE A PART HEREOF.
